description: This file contains JavaScript code for API interactions related to user data in a frontend project. It defines functions to fetch user projects and minimal user info from backend endpoints, utilizing an API client and handling query parameters, errors, and environment-specific debug logging.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from the backend using specified parameters, with support for date normalization and environment-based debug logging.
